analysis_unit: valid generated molecule nested within model-pocket-seed job
input_scope: 45 terminal-success primary jobs only; canaries excluded
identity_definition: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES after hydrogen removal
reference: the crystallographic ligand supplied for the same pocket

pocket_metrics.pocket_compatible: all generated heavy atoms lie within 10 A of at least one reference-ligand heavy atom

claim_limits: Reference-ligand dissimilarity is a local structural comparison and does not establish training-set novelty.
Known-active and training-set nearest-neighbor claims remain not_measured until versioned comparison collections are supplied.
Pocket compatibility and clash metrics are geometric computational signals and do not establish binding affinity.
